help_hidden_body:
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Displays all hidden tanks in the research tree: premium, collectible, test and deprecated vehicles become visible in their branches. The mod only shows the vehicles — purchase still depends on the developers' offers.

WHICH FILES ARE CHANGED (relative to Data/):
• Configs/TechTree/*_tree.yaml — 9 files (one per nation)
• XML/item_defs/vehicles/*/list.xml — 9 files (one per nation)
Total: 18 files. In DLC (packs/): same paths with .dvpl extension — always DVPL.

HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• In list.xml sets notInShop=false and cleans the hiding tags (deprecated, secret, testTank and others).
• In *_tree.yaml appends hidden tanks with new position entries: ordinary first, then collectible, then premium.
• Adds the unified #HuntezPatch - Generated: date /// time [timezone] header (e.g. 19.01.2026 /// 00:21 [GMT+03]) and an <!-- HuntezPatch - Generated: ... --> comment in list.xml; the program uses them to detect modified files.

IMPACT:
• Research tree and vehicle lists only.
• Does not touch balance, prices, hangar or account progress.
• If packs contains a micro-update with new tanks, enable “Modify DLC”, otherwise update vehicles stay hidden.
help_autoranks_body:
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Disables rank gating in the interface: the Battle button is always visible, rank-unlock hints are hidden, rank-up events are removed, and the “your tank has a rank” celebration no longer pops up.

WHICH FILES ARE CHANGED (relative to Data/):
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Hangar/Hangar.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Hangar/Squad/SquadView.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Inventory/Inventory.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Inventory/TankProgress/AchievementsTab.yaml
Total: 4 files. In DLC (packs/): same paths with .dvpl extension — always DVPL.

HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• Mirrors the reference mod 1:1. Adds the unified #HuntezPatch - Generated: date /// time [timezone] header (e.g. 19.01.2026 /// 00:21 [GMT+03]).
• bindings ["visible", "not rankUnlockRequired"] → ["visible", ""].
• Cuts "not rankUnlockRequired and " out of conditions.
• Deletes the "rankUnlockRequired": "rankUnlockRequired" passthrough and the SquadView local param.
• Removes UnlockRank and OnPromoRankInfoClicked from events.
• Cuts UnlockRank/UnlockFirstRank/FirstRankSoundPlayed/OnPromoRankInfoClicked elements out of eventActions (emptied items and blocks are removed).
• needsUnlock: not isNull(dossier.rankState) → isNull(dossier.rankState).
• ranksAvailable: not isNull(selectedTank) → isNull(selectedTank) — the rank master switch.

IMPACT:
• Lobby and hangar visuals only.
• Does not touch the research tree, balance or account progress.

TANKS BLITZ (LESTA) — OWN STRUCTURE (v5): the rank screen works as usual, the GET RANK button is available. Cut: the auto-grant (two init animations fired UnlockFirstRank by themselves — lines removed) and notifications (hangar teaser/counters + sounds, promo popup, lightning, ceremony fanfare, TankRankAvailable/TankRanksUnlocked popups — pushed by native code with no yaml references, so killed via root visible: false, like the WG reference hides UnlockRankHint). Manual acquisition — by button only, like on WoT Blitz. Files for Tanks Blitz: 9 (4 yaml + actions + 2 animation + 2 popups).
help_random_tank_body:
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Adds a two-dice button to the hangar tanks panel — pressing it selects a random owned tank.

WHICH FILES ARE CHANGED (relative to Data/):
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Hangar/TanksPanel/TanksPanel.yaml
• UI/Screens3/Lobby/Hangar/TanksPanel/TanksPanel.actions
• Gfx/Lobby/icons/randomtankselector_button_icon.packed.webp(.dvpl) plus the @2x variant — NEW files.
Total: 3 files. In DLC (packs/): same paths with .dvpl extension — always DVPL.

HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• Inserts the RandomTankButtonHolder button into TanksPanel.yaml, in front of the filter panel.
• Inserts the SELECT_RANDOM_TANK action into TanksPanel.actions: random tank pick plus carousel scroll to it.
• Generates the dice icon on every run (each die shows its own pip number, transparent background).
• Adds the unified #HuntezPatch - Generated: date /// time [timezone] header (e.g. 19.01.2026 /// 00:21 [GMT+03]) to yaml and //HuntezPatch - Generated: ... to actions.

IMPACT:
• Hangar tanks panel and the new icon only.
• Restoring the original removes the added icon from the game files.

TANKS BLITZ (LESTA): unavailable — the client already ships the official random picker in the tank filter (official option — not needed).

help_server_select_body:
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
- Pins the server list instead of the map (the view toggle and the cluster dialog are dead in the release client; dev buttons removed).
- Clusters live UNDER their own server as rows like localized name + (EU_C0) suffix (rendered by the row template). The untouched original is auto-pick. Confirm with the stock button.
- Login screens (Entry/NewGame): 'your server' and 'last login' lines also show the name + cluster suffix.
- List search accepts every language.
- Regions are numbered (001 Europe, 002 Europe EU_C0, …), so list order is identical in every language. Re-select your server once after generating (keys change).

WHERE REGIONS LIVE: the client reads the list from the region_cache (WoT Blitz: %LocalAppData%/wotblitz/DAVAProject/region_cache, Tanks Blitz: %userprofile%/Documents/TanksBlitz/region_cache; file picked by Data/version). The mod patches the cache (marks it read-only, so the game cannot silently rebuild it) plus the Data twins of regions_publish.yaml as the source. Close the game before generating. If a game update wipes the clusters, the cache was rebuilt: just regenerate. Restore also clears read-only.

WHICH FILES ARE CHANGED:
- UI/Screens3/PreLogin/ServerSelection.yaml: toggle hidden, list forced, search opened.
- UI/Screens3/PreLogin/ServerDescriptionPrototype.yaml: cluster second line.
- UI/Screens3/PreLogin/Entry.yaml, NewGame.yaml: selected-server name+suffix.
- regions in Data and the region_cache: per-cluster copies + numbering.
Total: 9 files.

IMPACT:
- WoT Blitz (Wargaming) only: Tanks Blitz has no server selection screen at the app level, the mod is unavailable there.
- Login screen only. Changing region = different account/progress. Changing cluster inside a region keeps progress (same realm).
